# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Puzzles

---

## 1. BY PRIMARY MECHANIC

### 1.1 Loop/Path Drawing
*Draw a single continuous loop or path through the grid*

#### 1.1.1 Pure Loop Construction
- **Masyu** — Loop constrained by black/white circle turn rules
- **Slitherlink** — Loop on grid edges constrained by number clues
- **Mid-loop** — Loop where black circles are midpoints of straight segments
- **Nagareru** — Directed loop with wind constraints
- **Moon-or-Sun** — Loop alternating between moon/sun symbols across rooms
- **Dotchi-Loop** — Loop with per-region straight-or-turn constraints on white circles
- **Suraromu** — Loop passing through numbered gates in order

#### 1.1.2 Loop + Shading Hybrid
- **Yajilin** — Loop avoiding black cells; arrow clues count black cells in a direction

#### 1.1.3 Path Connection
- **Numberlink** — Connect pairs of identical numbers with non-crossing paths
- **Hashiwokakero** — Connect island nodes with 1–2 bridges to form a connected network

---

### 1.2 Cell Shading / Painting
*Determine which cells are black (shaded) and which are white*

#### 1.2.1 Shading with Connectivity Constraints
- **Nurikabe** — Black cells form one connected wall with no 2×2; white islands sized by numbers
- **Kurodoko** — Black cells non-adjacent; white cells connected; numbers count visible white cells
- **Kurotto** — Numbers in circles indicate sum of adjacent black cell groups
- **Heyawake** — Room-based shading; white cells can't span 3+ rooms in a line
- **Norinori** — Exactly two shaded cells per region, each part of a domino
- **Nurimisaki** — White "promontory" cells with one white neighbor; no 2×2 of either color
- **Nurimeizu** — Shading creates a maze from S to G with room-level all-or-nothing coloring
- **Nuritwin** — Each region has exactly two same-sized shaded blocks; all shading connected
- **LITS** — Place one tetromino per region; same-shape tetrominoes non-adjacent; all connected; no 2×2

#### 1.2.2 Shading Forming Rectangles/Geometric Shapes
- **Choco Banana** — Black groups must be rectangles; white groups must not be rectangles
- **Shakashaka** — Place triangles so remaining white areas form rectangles
- **Tilepaint** — Color entire tiles (all-or-nothing) to match row/column black-cell counts

#### 1.2.3 Shading with Deception
- **Usowan** — Like Heyawake-style shading, but exactly one clue per room is a liar

#### 1.2.4 Shading with Gravity/Physics
- **Sto-stone** — Shade cells in rooms; when "dropped" downward, stones fill bottom half of grid

---

### 1.3 Region Division / Partitioning
*Divide the grid into regions or blocks according to constraints*

#### 1.3.1 Rectangular Partitioning
- **Shikaku** — Divide grid into rectangles, each containing exactly one number equal to its area

#### 1.3.2 Fixed-Size Partitioning
- **Five Cells** — Divide grid into pentominoes; border clues count surrounding block edges

#### 1.3.3 Shape-Constrained Partitioning
- **Sashigane** — Divide grid into L-shaped blocks; circles mark bends, arrows mark ends
- **Double Choco** — Divide into blocks where white and gray halves have matching shapes

#### 1.3.4 Number-Driven Partitioning
- **Fillomino** — Fill numbers and partition into polyominoes sized by their number; same-size blocks non-adjacent

---

### 1.4 Number/Symbol Placement
*Fill cells with numbers or symbols according to constraints*

#### 1.4.1 Latin Square Variants
- **Sudoku** — Place 1–9 in rows, columns, and 3×3 boxes
- **Hitori** — Black out duplicates so no number repeats in any row/column; white cells connected

#### 1.4.2 Room-Based Number Fill
- **Ripple Effect** — Fill rooms with 1–N; same numbers in a line must be spaced apart
- **Makaro** — Fill rooms with 1–N; arrows in black cells point to the largest adjacent number
- **Nansuke** — Place given multi-digit numbers into a crossword-style grid

#### 1.4.3 Symbol Placement
- **Juosan** — Fill every cell with — or |; territory clues constrain the difference; run-length limits apply

---

### 1.5 Object Placement
*Place specific objects (light bulbs, snakes, pencils, etc.) into the grid*

#### 1.5.1 Light/Illumination
- **Akari** — Place light bulbs to illuminate all white cells; bulbs can't see each other; numbered black cells constrain adjacent bulb count

#### 1.5.2 Entity Placement
- **Hebi** — Place snakes (1–5 sequences) with adjacency and line-of-sight restrictions
- **Pencils** — Mark out pencil shapes and draw lines from tips of specified length
- **Evolomino** — Place growing polyomino blocks along arrow paths

---

### 1.6 Movement / Rearrangement
*Move existing objects to satisfy constraints*

- **Satogaeri** — Move circles within countries so each country has exactly one; numbered circles move exact distances; paths can't cross
- **Yosenabe** — Slide circles straight into gray areas; numbers in gray areas equal sum of entering circles

---

### 1.7 Block/Chain Construction
*Build or identify connected block structures*

- **Chained Block** — Determine black cells forming blocks; blocks chain at corners; unique shapes per chain

---

## 2. BY CLUE TYPE

### 2.1 Numeric Clues (Counting)
- **Adjacency counts:** Akari, Shakashaka, Slitherlink, Five Cells, Usowan
- **Visibility/reach counts:** Kurodoko, Nurimisaki, Yajilin, Akari
- **Region size:** Shikaku, Fillomino, Choco Banana, Nurikabe, Double Choco, Nuritwin
- **Sum of groups:** Kurotto
- **Sequence/order:** Suraromu, Hebi
- **Difference/balance:** Juosan

### 2.2 Directional Clues (Arrows)
- Makaro, Yajilin, Hebi, Nagareru, Pencils, Evolomino, Sashigane, Yosenabe

### 2.3 Symbolic Clues (Circles, Moons, Suns)
- Masyu (black/white circles), Moon-or-Sun, Dotchi-Loop, Mid-loop, Satogaeri, Nurimisaki

### 2.4 Structural Clues (Bold-line Regions)
- Heyawake, LITS, Norinori, Ripple Effect, Makaro, Double Choco, Nurimeizu, Sto-stone, Nuritwin, Moon-or-Sun, Dotchi-Loop, Five Cells

### 2.5 No/Minimal Clues (Purely Structural)
- Numberlink (paired numbers only), Hashiwokakero (island numbers only)

---

## 3. BY GRID ELEMENT USED

| Grid Element | Puzzles |
|---|---|
| **Cell centers** (shading/numbers) | Nurikabe, Hitori, Sudoku, Fillomino, Heyawake, Kurotto, Kurodoko, Choco Banana, Norinori, LITS, Shakashaka, Sto-stone, Nurimisaki, Nurimeizu, Nuritwin, Usowan, Tilepaint, Chained Block, Akari, Nansuke, Ripple Effect, Makaro, Juosan, Hebi |
| **Cell centers** (loop paths) | Masyu, Mid-loop, Nagareru, Moon-or-Sun, Dotchi-Loop, Suraromu, Yajilin |
| **Grid edges/dots** (loop on edges) | Slitherlink |
| **Between cells** (bridges) | Hashiwokakero |
| **Cell centers** (connecting paths) | Numberlink |
| **Region boundaries** (partitioning) | Shikaku, Five Cells, Sashigane, Double Choco, Fillomino |
| **Object placement** | Akari (bulbs), Hebi (snakes), Pencils, Evolomino (squares) |
| **Object movement** | Satogaeri, Yosenabe |

---

## 4. BY CONSTRAINT FAMILY

### 4.1 Connectivity
- **White cells connected:** Hitori, Kurodoko, Nurikabe, Nurimisaki, Heyawake, Usowan, Nurimeizu
- **Black cells connected:** Nurikabe (wall), LITS, Nuritwin
- **Network connected:** Hashiwokakero
- **Single loop:** Masyu, Slitherlink, Mid-loop, Nagareru, Moon-or-Sun, Dotchi-Loop, Suraromu, Yajilin

### 4.2 Non-adjacency
- **Black cells non-adjacent:** Kurodoko, Yajilin, Heyawake, Usowan, Hitori
- **Same-shape non-adjacent:** LITS
- **Same-size non-adjacent:** Fillomino

### 4.3 No 2×2 Constraint
- Nurikabe, LITS, Nurimisaki, Nurimeizu, Sto-stone, Nuritwin

### 4.4 Uniqueness in Row/Column
- Sudoku, Hitori

### 4.5 Rectangular Formation
- **Must form rectangles:** Choco Banana (black), Shakashaka (white), Shikaku
- **Must not form rectangles:** Choco Banana (white)

---

## 5. VISUAL SUMMARY TREE

```
Grid-Based Logic Puzzles
├── DRAW (loops/paths/bridges)
│   ├── Single Loop
│   │   ├── On cell centers: Masyu, Mid-loop, Nagareru, Moon-or-Sun,
│   │   │   Dotchi-Loop, Suraromu, Yajilin
│   │   └── On grid edges: Slitherlink
│   ├── Multiple Paths: Numberlink
│   └── Network/Bridges: Hashiwokakero
│
├── SHADE (black/white cells)
│   ├── Connectivity-focused: Nurikabe, Kurodoko, Heyawake, Nurimisaki,
│   │   Nurimeizu, LITS, Norinori, Nuritwin, Usowan
│   ├── Shape-focused: Choco Banana, Shakashaka, Tilepaint
│   ├── Elimination: Hitori
│   ├── Gravity: Sto-stone
│   └── Sum/counting: Kurotto, Akari (illumination)
│
├── DIVIDE (partition grid)
│   ├── Into rectangles: Shikaku
│   ├── Into fixed-size pieces: Five Cells
│   ├── Into L-shapes: Sashigane
│   ├── Into matched pairs: Double Choco
│   └── Into number-sized polyominoes: Fillomino
│
├── FILL (numbers/symbols)
│   ├── Latin-style: Sudoku, Hitori
│   ├── Room-based: Ripple Effect, Makaro, Nansuke
│   └── Symbol fill: Juosan
│
├── PLACE (objects)
│   ├── Light bulbs: Akari
│   ├── Snakes: Hebi
│   ├── Pencils + lines: Pencils
│   ├── Growing blocks: Evolomino
│   └── Chained blocks: Chained Block
│
└── MOVE (objects)
    ├── Satogaeri
    └── Yosenabe
```
